title: Stock Markets and Financial Markets
text: A stock market is a marketplace where shares of publicly listed companies are bought and sold. Major stock exchanges include the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE), NASDAQ, the London Stock Exchange, and the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Stock prices reflect investors' expectations about future company earnings, influenced by economic conditions, company performance, and market sentiment. Stock market indices like the S&P 500, Dow Jones Industrial Average, and FTSE 100 track the performance of groups of stocks. Bull markets are characterized by rising prices and investor optimism, while bear markets involve declining prices of 20% or more from recent highs. The first modern stock exchange was established in Amsterdam in 1602 with the Dutch East India Company.
